second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 9 + Average 7 + Difficulty 4 = 20), pdf 89; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-20 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-5, II 6-10, III 11-15, IV 16-20). Answer side keys 1-20 in order (pdf 126-127). BLUE PRINT 9/7/4 = 20 = audited count. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 20.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 89 (heading, LO 13, BLUE PRINT, q1-3) 90 (q4-13) 91 (q13 options-20). A side 'Sample answers. 23. The Earth - Our Home' pdf 126 (keys 1-19), pdf 127 top (20). Folios = pdf page.
ANSWER SIDE (analysed first): keys 1-20 answer q1-q20 by printed number (aligned).

Sections: s1 I fill q1-5; s2 II match q6-10 (numbered rows -> one-pair match; row 10's left item 'Shape of the Earth' is also printed in column B and the key pairs it with itself — as printed); s3 III mcq q11-15 (three options -> 'source notation inconsistent'; text-only keys all match by pass 1); s4 IV q16-20.

KEYS: q17's key is garbled by machine translation ('…comes.PoetThe cloud is moving. PoeticIt seems dark … Appear') — stored verbatim, unflagged (it addresses the question in part). q19: the stem's 'earthworm "Ghola"' renders the word for globe; the key describes a sphere -> 'key text does not address question' (review-blocking; the stem is the likely defect). q20 (draw a sphere model) key is an instruction 'Children They draw a picture of the earth according to their own discretion.' -> stored verbatim (as the cleared Class-4 instruction key).
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 20 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 13, lo_source 'lesson_table'.
FIGURES: none on these pages; q20 asks to draw a sphere (not a map; no map rulings). TOPIC evs-3-23-t00 / chapter / high (R-E3).
